commit.message:
Refs #36439 -- Added missing thread_sensitive=False to dummy password hasher path.

The existing user path also uses thread_sensitive=False in acheck_password().

Follow-up to 7f66c3b41f0fb0fb938d7b96e20a28dccdaa2ecd.
Fixed #37019 -- Updated login() and logout() to set request.auser.

Refs #36439 -- Added sync_to_async() to dummy password hasher path.

Since the existing user path eventually calls sync_to_async() in acheck_password,
aim for parity with the nonexistent/inactive user branch by adding sync_to_async().

Follow-up to 748ca0a146175c4868ece87f5e845a75416c30e3.

Fixed #36901 -- Centralized auth timing attack mitigations.

Thank you Mar Bartolome and Tim Schilling for reviews.

Fixed #37017 -- Fixed setting or clearing of request.user after alogin/alogout().

Regression in 31a43c571f4d036827d4fd7a5f615591637dc1be.

Fixed #36903 -- Fixed further NameErrors when inspecting functions with deferred annotations.

Provide a wrapper for safe introspection of user functions on Python 3.14+.

Follow-up to 601914722956cc41f1f2c53972d669ddee6ffc04.

Refs #35530 -- Removed request.user or auser() fallback in auth.login and auth.alogin.

Per deprecation timeline.

Fixed #36572 -- Revert "Fixed #36546 -- Deprecated django.utils.crypto.constant_time_compare() in favor of hmac.compare_digest()."

This reverts commit 0246f478882c26bc1fe293224653074cd46a90d0.

Fixed #36546 -- Deprecated django.utils.crypto.constant_time_compare() in favor of hmac.compare_digest().

Signed-off-by: SaJH <wogur981208@gmail.com>

Refs #35530 -- Corrected deprecation message in auth.alogin().

Follow up to ceecd518b19044181a3598c55ebed7c2545963cc.

Refs #35303 -- Made small optimizations in alogout() and aget_user().

In alogout(), there is no need to check the is_authenticated attribute
when user is None.

In aget_user(), there is no need to call get_session_auth_hash() twice.

Follow up to 50f89ae850f6b4e35819fe725a08c7e579bfd099.

commit.message: Fixed #36540 -- Updated request.auser() in contrib.auth.alogin() and contrib.auth.alogout().
Fixed #35530 -- Deprecated request.user fallback in auth.login and auth.alogin.
Fixed #35303 -- Implemented async auth backends and utils.

Fixed #34901 -- Added async-compatible interface to session engines.

Thanks Andrew-Chen-Wang for the initial implementation which was posted
to the Django forum thread about asyncifying contrib modules.
Fixed #34391 -- Added async-compatible interface to auth functions and related methods test clients.

Fixed #34384 -- Fixed session validation when rotation secret keys.

Bug in 0dcd549bbe36c060f536ec270d34d9e7d4b8e6c7.

Thanks Eric Zarowny for the report.
